title: Render the Pav Dental Welcome landing screen and open the email sign-in sheet
description: Verify that opening / displays the Pav Dental welcome screen ('Oral Wellness & Aesthetic Dentistry') and clicking 'Sign In' or 'Or sign in with email address ›' reveals the 'Welcome back' email entry form with the 'Continue' button.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:8081/
Verify 'Pav Dental' and 'Oral Wellness' text are visible on the welcome screen
Click the 'Sign In' button or 'Or sign in with email address ›' button
Verify 'Welcome back', the 'name@example.co.uk' email input, and the 'Continue' button are displayed

title: Sign in via /sign-in and reach the authenticated Patient Home Dashboard
description: Verify that navigating to /sign-in, entering email test@pavdental.com and password Password123!, and clicking 'Sign In' authenticates the user and redirects to the Patient Home Dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:8081/sign-in
Fill in the email input (placeholder 'name@example.co.uk') with test@pavdental.com
Fill in the password input (placeholder 'Enter your password') with Password123!
Click the 'Sign In' button
Verify the authenticated Patient Home Dashboard is displayed with bottom navigation tabs (Home, Bookings, Records, Messages, Profile)

title: Sign in using the 1-tap Patient demo button on /sign-in
description: Verify that clicking the 'Patient' quick-fill pill on /sign-in populates patient@pavdental.com and Password123!, and clicking 'Sign In' lands on the Patient Home Dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:8081/sign-in
Click the 'Patient' demo quick-fill button
Click the 'Sign In' button
Verify the user is redirected to the Patient Home Dashboard

title: Navigate to the Bookings tab after signing in and view appointments
description: Verify that after signing in at /sign-in, clicking the 'Bookings' tab in the bottom navigation bar displays the patient's appointments and booking options.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:8081/sign-in
Click the 'Patient' demo quick-fill button and click 'Sign In'
Click the 'Bookings' tab in the bottom navigation bar
Verify the Appointments / Bookings screen is displayed

title: Navigate to the Records tab after signing in and view clinical records
description: Verify that after signing in at /sign-in, clicking the 'Records' tab displays the patient's dental records and odontogram chart.

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:8081/sign-in
Click the 'Patient' demo quick-fill button and click 'Sign In'
Click the 'Records' tab in the bottom navigation bar
Verify the dental records view is displayed
